en.name: Basilica of the Holy Blood, Bruges
en.summary: A medieval basilica venerating a relic said to hold blood collected at the crucifixion of Christ.
en.body: Built in the mid-twelfth century and expanded over the following centuries, the basilica in Bruges venerates a rock-crystal vial said to contain blood of Christ, brought from the Holy Land during the Second Crusade.
